jobs.description: About Us | Hear We make intelligence that deepens human connection. Connections matter more than ever. But they’re also harder than ever to build or keep. Too much data Too much noise What once felt personal now feels out of reach. That’s why we built Hear. Our story It started with passion. And countless late nights. Our Founders, Noam and Yossi have been building together for over 15 years. What began as a shared curiosity about technology and communication became a journey of creating products that matter. They co-founded four companies along the way, including Predictad, Sensiya (acquired by i.am+), and over.ai (acquired by Vonage). Each step sharpened a single belief: AI shouldn’t replace people, it should help people understand each other better. In 2023, they started Hear to bring that belief to life. Today, Hear combines everything they’ve learned across AI and customer experience - focused, ambitious, and built to make intelligence feel like intuition, not overload. Because when people understand one another, everything else works better.
